question: What's the cut-off for submitting overtime this month?

answer.headline: Don't act yet — sources disagree
answer.detail: 20th of the month (C) vs 25th of the month (D) for Van Dam Logistics NV (BE).

sources.title: Payroll variables cut-off — Belgium
sources.statement: Payroll variables for Belgian clients must be submitted by the 20th of the month.
sources.quote: must be submitted by the 20th of the month
sources.body: From 1 July 2026, payroll variables (overtime, absences, bonuses) for Belgian clients must be submitted by the 20th of the month to be included in that month's payroll run. Variables received later are processed in the next run. This replaces the previous cut-off on the 22nd.

applicability.text: Applies to all clients in Belgium

reasons.text: Client-specific exception (25th of the month) claimed in Teams · #payroll-be, not verified

sources.body: Q: What is the monthly cut-off for payroll variables? A: The 20th of each month, since July 2026. Late variables move to the next payroll run.
